outcome: Pro-inflammatory cytokines in plasma (e.g., IL-6, TNF-a)
Cytokine mRNA expression in brain (paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus and hippocampus)
Microglial number and morphology in brain
cohort: The study participants were mouse offspring.
finding: Birth triggers a significant immune response in the body and brain of offspring, characterized by surges in corticosterone and specific cytokines, and rapid increases in microglial cell number.
mod_finding: While surges in corticosterone and IL-10 just after birth were regardless of birth mode, there were subtle differences by birth mode in the rapid increases in microglial cell number in the brain.
